utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still on the fence, honestly—I need to know people are actually sticking to the side street before I count on the driveway staying clear.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll stick to the side street, and I’m still meeting Gus at 9 for the gutters before we head to the fence. If that helps, you can count on my car staying out of the driveway.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That does help, thanks—I just want to be sure a few other people are doing the same before I plan on coming by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: From what I’ve heard, Milo’s definitely bringing a toolbox and fasteners, and Priya’s set aside bike tubes and patch kits already.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great—toolbox, fasteners, and bike patch stuff will go a long way. If Tess can spread the word too, we could still use extension cords, spare screwdrivers, and maybe a folding table or two.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll pass that along, Quinn—right now Milo’s confirmed on the toolbox and fasteners, and Priya’s got the tubes and patch kits, so extension cords, spare screwdrivers, and folding tables are the big asks.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: From what I’ve heard, they’re still gathering tools—extension cords, spare screwdrivers, and maybe a couple folding tables seem to be the big needs.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That lines up with what I’m hearing too—I’ll keep asking around, and I’m still looking for someone who can lead the roof work while Faye covers sorting or phone outreach after drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds right to me—I’ve only been hearing second-hand, but Quinn and Rosa both made it sound like folks are piecing things together as they go.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Dane, Noah’s still getting the repair drive plan straight, but once he sends me the details, I’ll let everyone know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—I’ll still be coming by a bit late, and when I get there I can start on sorting the tools for a while.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, Dane—I’ll pass that along too, and as soon as Noah sends me the repair drive details, I’ll let everyone know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I assign Gus, can we confirm who’s leading the center’s roof and whether there’s actually a one-story gutter job at 9?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m not sure on either—best bet is to check the schedule or flyer before you send Gus.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Okay, let’s verify the schedule first—I don’t want to assign Gus until we confirm whether there’s a 9 o’clock one-story gutter job and who’s leading the center’s roof.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Kira — yes, we’re still collecting tools, and the repair drive’s been moved to Sunday at the community center. If you want, I can tell you what we still need most.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That’s useful, but can you confirm who’s definitely bringing tools and parts, and whether people are actually using the side street so the driveway stays clear?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: A few neighbors have already dropped off tools, but I don’t want to promise names until I check the list; as for parking, we’re asking folks to use the side street so the driveway stays clear.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s wait for Opal to confirm the exact spot, Sam, and then we’ll keep the rest to a short checklist so nothing gets muddled.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That works for me—I’ll keep the checklist short and wait for Opal to confirm the spot before I send anything around.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Sam—that keeps it tidy. Once Opal confirms the spot, we’ll note it and send around one clear list of who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can pitch in for the repair drive after school drop-off and before 2, especially if there’s sorting or calls to handle.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you handle calls for me and confirm whether we’ve got a one-story gutter job for Gus at 9, and who’s pairing with him?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I can make those calls after drop-off and check whether Gus has that one-story gutter job at 9 and who’s paired with him.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Opal, I’m getting the list set this afternoon, and so far I’ve got my toolbox, a fold-up table, and Eli’s labels and sign-up stuff on it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That sounds organized, Oren—I’m still confirming the exact spot on the flyer so we’ve got the right location before we lock the rest in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, good—once you’ve got the spot confirmed, I’ll send Ira the list this afternoon so she can coordinate pickups, unless I’ve left off something obvious.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, once Oren sends the list this afternoon, I’ll coordinate with Leo while I’m out so pickups stay on track.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, thanks, Ira. I’m still getting the repair drive details straight, but once I’ve got the plan together I’ll send it over.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect—send it over this afternoon once it’s together, and I’ll coordinate with Leo while I’m out so pickups stay on track.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mara, we still need the fence patched and the tools sorted, so if you can take one of those, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can take the tool sorting, and we should still keep the porch steps and the center’s roof as the top priorities while Joel handles carpentry and Priya covers supplies.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Mara—thanks for taking the tool sorting; I’ll keep the fence patching moving and make sure the porch steps and center roof stay at the top of the list.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can be there around 9 with my ladder and toolbox, and we can start with the gutters before moving over to the fence.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That works—bring the ladder and toolbox at 9, and we’ll start on the gutters then move to the fence.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—I’ll be there around 9 with the ladder and toolbox, ready to start on the gutters.
